metadata.title: A study on factors influencing digital sports participation among Chinese secondary school students based on explainable machine learning

design_fields.q1_rationale: Plausible values are not applicable because the dependent variable is a binary indicator of digital sports participation, not a PV-based cognitive achievement score.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The study explicitly states that it did not apply sampling weights in the analysis.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study used multilevel logistic regression, which accounts for school clustering in the analysis.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study performed internal validation using 5-fold cross-validation and did not mention any validation on external datasets.
